RESOLVED: Dear Dana, 

I've reviewed your claim for the brain MRI on August 27, which was denied due to a missing prior authorization. You have the right to appeal this decision within 180 days of the denial notice date. The exact deadline for your appeal is December 2, 2026. 

To initiate the appeal process, please ask your doctor to submit a retrospective authorization request with clinical documentation supporting the medical necessity of the MRI. You can also request the appeal form (FORM-APP-1) from our office. We will decide on your appeal within 30 calendar days of receiving the necessary documentation. 

If you have any further questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to us. We're here to help. 

Sincerely,
ARIA, Meridian Health Plan Member Services
